Harry Potter had TWO surviving connections to his parents after Prisoner of Azkaban: Sirius Black and Remus Lupin.

So why does Harry almost immediately turn to Sirius for help… while Lupin fades into the background?

Today we explore one of the saddest relationship dynamics in the entire Harry Potter series — and why Lupin may have unintentionally taught Harry not to rely on him.

From Goblet of Fire to Order of the Phoenix, the difference between Sirius and Lupin comes down to one thing: Availability vs vulnerability.
